title: Research UT3(F4) central commutator costs
body:
## Contribution

A construction-focused bit-mechanism experiment in the exact address algebra `F2[UT_3(F_4)]`. The package resolves one two-register target exactly and records one bounded three-register construction screen. It supplies no selected-supplier mapping or new `kappa`.

## Results

- For the four paid involution labels `X_1`, `X_w`, `Y_1`, `Y_w` and all six rank-one idempotents in `M2(F2)`, the target `diag([Z_1],[Z_w])` has exact minimum 8 calls. The coordinate commutators attain 8. A complete exact meet-in-the-middle over the radius-three ball excludes every word through six; the `I/I^2` trace lemma shows every valid target word has even length, excluding seven.
- A bounded pivot tests the dependent three-role target `diag([Z_1],[Z_w],[Z_{w^2}])`. The direct coordinate bill is 14. Exhausting all 178,808 ordered sequences of up to three four-call `D_N(Z_1)` / `D_N(Z_w)` blocks in `M3(F2)` finds no hit. This is only a negative result for that block family, not for arbitrary words at 12 calls or fewer. A source-label direct 14-call word is checked in both the packed and generic full group-algebra implementations.

The exact scope, group law, parity proof, complete cost account, search domain, controls and open question are in `research/ut3-f4-central-pair-seedfcd785a2/README.md`.

## Verification

Passed locally under CPython 3.14.7:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/ut3-f4-central-pair-seedfcd785a2/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/ut3-f4-central-pair-seedfcd785a2/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut3-f4-central-pair-seedfcd785a2 --check-only
```

Both exact verifier modes reproduce the certificate, including the 6,877-state ball digests, 10,488 packed/generic transition checks, 56 full commutator-block endpoint checks, 3,136 generic central-block products, and deletion/mutation controls. The repository's registered replay command requires Python 3.12, which is unavailable locally; the registered package check-only passed. The bindings-only research baseline passed in the full sibling checkout at `bc63155a531d814dd8fa98993d84dc287756ad47`; its selected-record and source-chain hashes match the pinned Cycle AG inputs, and its baseline/checker scripts match `origin/main` byte for byte. No full selected cold replay was run because this contribution changes no selected source.

## Scope and credit

This is an exact finite group-algebra result for the stated group, labels, roles, targets and rank-one alphabet. It is not a supplier result, physical bit-circuit admission, or multiplication theorem. The package retains the Q8 central-commutator predecessor by Aaron Wang, the scalar-idempotent model from eumemic PR #288, and the nonabelian register lineage of woklerx PR #1443. Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.
